title: Angry ghast
description: Turns happy ghasts into angry ghasts, and regular ghasts into furious ghasts! Sloppily made for comedic effect, inspired by the 2025 april fools snapshot!
body:
Turns happy ghasts into angry ghasts, and regular ghasts into furious ghasts! Dried ghasts are also angry, the tears music disk is not NOT a cyclops and is ALSO angry for some reason. even the **DAMN ROPES** OF THE HAPPY GHAST WHILE CARRYING SOMETHING ON A LEADS are angry, hell, even the bone blocks are angry. Sloppily made for comedic effect, inspired by the 2025 april fools snapshot!

----------------------------

HOW TO DOWNLOAD:

1. download hte latest (only) version
2. cut it (CTRL+X) in the file explorer
3. go to C:\Users\[your microsoft account name]\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\resourcepacks if on microsoft
4. paste the resource pack into the resourcepacks folder
5. open minecraft on 1.21.6 or later
6. go to settings -> resource packs
7. put the angry ghast resource pack at the tippity top (unless you want other packs to override it)
